intro.title: Mini Redux
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simplified version of Redux, a state management library, from scratch using React and JavaScript. You will learn how to implement core Redux concepts like a single store, actions, and reducers to manage application state predictably. The main technologies involved are React's useState and useReducer hooks, along with plain JavaScript objects and functions for state updates. By the end, you will understand how Redux centralizes state and enables consistent data flow in a React application.
intro.usecase: The state management pattern taught in this lesson is the foundation for libraries like Redux and Zustand, which are used in complex web applications to handle data consistently. For example, in a large e-commerce dashboard, this pattern manages user carts, product filters, and order statuses across multiple components like sidebars, modals, and data tables. Developers apply it to ensure that UI elements like search filters or notification panels update predictably when state changes, avoiding bugs in interactive features. Mastering this concept helps you build scalable apps where state is centralized and easy to debug, a common requirement in professional React projects.
